SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.
   B. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.
   D. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.
   C. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.

4. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.
   C. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Compass Direction as rumours only.
   B. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Compass Direction.

6. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Measure rainfall only

7. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

8. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Historic Built Environments in the County as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments in the County.
   C. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Location and size of the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Location and size of the County as rumours only.
   B. Say Location and size of the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Location and size of the County.
   D. Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.
   B. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.
   D. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

12. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.
   B. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Economic activities in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Industries in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

10. B — Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
